content.text:
Stockout’s cockpit is **one chat** with six inline beats (shortage → timeline → candidates → live calls → claim-vs-record → PR). Steal from **agent workspaces that produce artifacts**, not from ERP dashboards.

## Base the product on these five

1. **[WRITER](https://mobbin.com/flows/05b3c653-52ee-4323-8170-2cb7e314c0da)** — Chat left, deliverables right. The agent writes a file, then shows it as the object to review. Closest match to `cases/<id>/` plus `decision.md`. Use this for A5–A6.

2. **[Lindy](https://mobbin.com/screens/9f4affd5-f387-4149-860e-95c83f9bbba5)** — Transcript on the left with a live checklist. Computer / browser on the right. The user watches work, they do not drive it. Use this for A2–A3.

3. **[incident.io](https://mobbin.com/screens/bf6f64ff-6ebc-4a7f-b354-f2a22066b03b)** — Incident as a first-class object: stage stepper, severity badge, “Ongoing for 24m 47s”, timeline of system events. Map that 1:1 onto the Shortage turn (hours-to-line-stop, Launch sourcing agent). Use this for A1–A2.

4. **[Microsoft Copilot — Deep Research](https://mobbin.com/flows/37ff9175-173d-4030-b71e-0e9ca59262b8)** — Progress lives **inside the chat** as a card (“I’m browsing… / I’ll write the report / Est. ~10 min”). That is the A1–A6 rule: turns and inline blocks, not extra routes.

5. **[Devin](https://mobbin.com/screens/1bee4b82-38f1-42a0-b500-aaf06efd2ea4)** — Worklog + PR + file diff as the finish line. Approval is merge, not an in-app button. Use this for A6 and the pitch.

## Steal one pattern per beat

1. **A4 live calls — [Vapi](https://mobbin.com/screens/3cafda24-5720-467a-a94a-bfeeba0a6ed3)**  
   Call metadata, dual-track recording, tabs for Transcript / Structured Outputs / Cost. Mask numbers. Keep the density.

2. **A4 transcript in a case — [Lightfield](https://mobbin.com/screens/91c2823c-fb49-459f-9bb8-e1f6b11efffe)**  
   Timestamped turns + “Ask …” on the same record. Good for CALL-E evidence without a call-center chrome.

3. **A6 artifacts — [Manus](https://mobbin.com/screens/a6af52d3-15ee-4bb1-88e9-3059b9614c21)**  
   “All files in this task” with type chips. Map to `sourcing_case.yaml`, `claims/*.json`, `policy_report.md`, `po_draft.md`.

4. **A3 / A6 engineering case — [Cursor](https://mobbin.com/screens/d744068a-1835-4c35-afa2-e560ccbe565d)**  
   Checklist + passing tests + diff. That is procurement-as-code: policy suite green before the PR.

5. **A4 call chrome only — [Grok Voice](https://mobbin.com/screens/8769afdd-9771-4073-a33e-69acf3019f0b)**  
   Green “Call connected 0:22” + End Call. Take the status bar. Skip the empty canvas.

## Do not copy

SaaS plan tables (Oyster, Mintlify, Webflow) are not claim-vs-record. Generic ChatGPT empty chat has no Incident, no Candidates, no Decision. Skype / Dialpad are phone products, not a sourcing cockpit.

**Recommended shell:** Copilot-style chat for the spine, incident.io for the shortage card, Lindy/WRITER for the working pane, Devin for the PR close.

These 15 screens split into those four shells.

1. **Recommended** — a board grouped by A1–A6 so you can scan steal-this vs skip-this side by side  
2. Describe your own layout (and any styling or other skills to apply)  
3. Just a text summary

Which would you like?

PRODUCT (from docs/PLAN.md Slice A, revised by designer):
- Stockout is a PLUGIN on top of an ERP. The ERP already shows the Incident/shortage (hours-to-line-stop, stock vs reorder). Do NOT include an incident.io-style incident dashboard as a Stockout screen.
- One cockpit surface. Chat on the LEFT. Deliverables / working object on the RIGHT (Writer + Devin structure; Devin has the better design).
- Right pane is context-sensitive (Manus "files in this task" as the default).
- Calling UI is Lindy-inspired transcript with a live checklist of what the call asked. Add a Grok-style "Call connected 0:22 / End" status bar. Optionally a scaled-down Vapi strip (duration, structured Claim fields) inside that transcript — not a full call-analytics dashboard.
- Skip Microsoft Copilot empty-chat aesthetic.
- Cursor inspiration: checklist + tests-green + diff as procurement-as-code evidence, not as an IDE clone.
- Human approval is merging a GitHub PR. No in-app approve/reject workflow.
- Domain words only: Incident, Supplier Record, Claim, Candidate, Outreach Task, Landed Cost, Strategy, Decision. Phone numbers masked. Rehearsal by default.

THE SHELL (same chrome on every artboard):
- Thin top bar: CASE-001, part 6204-2RS, rehearsal badge, Devin session link.
- LEFT ~58%: conversation thread (agent turns, inline cards).
- RIGHT ~42%: the working object (changes by screen).
- Bottom prompt only when the user can type; most of the demo is watch-only.

SCREENS TO FRAME (exactly these, as labeled artboards in one scrolling HTML page). Each artboard: 1440×900, light theme, black/white/gray only (project tokens: background white, foreground near-black, muted gray). Caption under each artboard: screen name + what the RIGHT pane shows + one line of why it exists.

1. **Opened from ERP** — User arrives already in a case. LEFT: one compact Incident chip (qty short, hours to line-stop, cost of standing still) + primary "Launch sourcing agent". RIGHT: empty Manus file list ("No artifacts yet") OR the seed files. Not a full incident page.

2. **Agent working** — LEFT: timeline turns (read system of record, 5 Candidates, compliance filter). One Candidate rejected with the rule named. RIGHT: Manus file list filling in (sourcing_case.yaml, candidates.json). Cursor-style checklist of stages.

3. **Live call (Lindy + Grok)** — LEFT: "Calling SKF München" turn. RIGHT: Lindy transcript (mandatory AI disclosure first, then answer-sheet questions including stock_status free vs allocated, price breaks). Grok status bar: connected, timer, masked number, End. Tiny Vapi-like strip: duration + Claim fields filling in.

4. **Second call / allocated stock beat** — Same chrome. RIGHT: another transcript where stock_status = in_stock_allocated. Show that beat clearly.

5. **Claim vs record** — LEFT: comparison announced in thread. RIGHT: side-by-side Claim | Supplier Record with deltas (price, lead time, cert, qty, stock_status). Landed-cost line items. This is the A5 punchline surface.

6. **Decision + files** — LEFT: recommended Strategy (split order), runner-ups, rationale. RIGHT: Manus files (decision.md, cost_report.md, policy_report.md, po_draft.md, claims/*.json) + Devin-style PR card (branch case/CASE-001, checks green, Open PR). No Approve button.

Also include a top INDEX on the HTML page: numbered list of the 6 screens with jump links, plus a one-line IA note: "ERP owns Incident. Stockout owns the sourcing run."

CONSTRAINTS:
- One HTML file, no frameworks, inline CSS.
- Wireframe fidelity: boxes, labels, real CASE-001 copy (bearing 6204-2RS, 12 days, 5 candidates, split order). Use fictional-range phones masked like +49 ••• ••• 5555.
- Do not invent extra routes (no settings, no login, no supplier directory, no ERP screens).
- Do not use Copilot-style empty greeting as a screen.
- Keep it scannable for an ADHD reader: big screen titles, short captions.

When done, return: path to the HTML, the 6 screen names, and what the right pane shows on each.
